lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Guatemala. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets representing IPC phase classifications for different scenarios and time periods in 2022.
